name: Shapes
what_it_does: Opens a gallery of ready-made shapes (lines, rectangles, arrows, callouts…) to draw into the document; a selected shape activates the Shape Format contextual tab (measured).
behavior: Opens Shapes (dropdown). Contents (162 controls): Shapes, Text Box, Line, Line Arrow, Rectangle, Oval, Rectangle: Rounded Corners, Isosceles Triangle, Connector: Elbow, Connector: Elbow Arrow, Arrow: Right, Arrow: Down, Freeform: Shape, Freeform: Scribble, Arc, Curve.
